name: Dir
reason: four unrelated constants (the four arrow actions / facings); no internal structure is read by any rule

name: Kind
reason: cost class of an action: mv / ck / fire

name: Nat (row, col, size, panel mask)
reason: pixel coordinates and a 9-bit mask; the rules use them only arithmetically

name: Level (floor, goal, recipes)
reason: per-level data read off the frames; the rules take it as a parameter

name: R-step (stepCore)
status: definition (stepCore_is_desc: it is the copairing of R-move and R-click)

name: R-click (toggle; fire iff mask equals one of this level's recipes; panel clears on fire)
reason: one branch of the stepCore copairing; L5eModel.clickRule

name: R-fire (applyEffect)
status: definition (applyEffect_is_desc; the shrink branch is now sizeToggle, attempt 3)

name: R-open condition ocBox
status: definition (attempt 2; ocBox_is_desc: copairing of ocVert / ocHoriz)

name: R-budget (game over when an action is sent with the bar empty; costs per kind)
reason: The unit model C5u (move/click 1, firing click 2, refill 10, budget 35; display 4*ceil(32*(35-u)/35)) fits all observed level-5 readings. An action may be sent only while u < 35 (l5_replay4_budget reproduces the GAME_OVER step).

name: first action after /reset swallowed
reason: Observed once, right after /reset on level 1 (tid 2b3e5ed8): the frame was unchanged and no bar was spent. It did not recur after level changes, so it is kept out of step and handled by adaptive replay instead.

name: colour-14 square covered by a 4x4 (L4)
reason: A 4x4 covering a 14-pad has no effect and the pad reappears afterwards (L4 tids a9960c82, 4385a4f9). The model only lets a 2x2 landing exactly on the pad consume it, so 4x4 cover is a no-op there too.
status: consequence of R-refill (usePads requires size 2 and an exact top-left)

name: board clicks outside the panel are no-ops
reason: One board click on the colour-6 box (L3 tid 0a171a67) produced an identical frame and no bar change. Act therefore has only panel clicks; board clicks are left out as no-ops.
status: not in the model (Act has no board clicks)

name: blocked move turns the block (attempt 4)
reason: The blocked branch of moveRule sets face := d and leaves everything else unchanged (tid 8e11f274). The attempt-1 'keeps facing' entry is withdrawn.

name: BoxSpec
status: definition: a BoxSpec is an Orient-tagged (row, col); orCocone is its coproduct presentation

name: gates : List Bool
reason: One opened-flag per 6-box, in level order. It replaces the attempt-1 Gate record, whose two slots were always negations of each other.

name: pads : List Bool
reason: One consumed-flag per 14-pad. L5 tid 88632a96 consumed the pad, and it stayed floor afterwards.

name: R-refill (usePads + Kind.mvR + Costs.refill)
reason: A pad is consumed when its 2x2 lies inside the block's new square aligned to the block's 2x2 sub-grid, for either size (attempt 4: a 4x4 at r37 c49 refilled 10 units). It sits in the moved branch of the moveRule copairing.

name: R-tp (tpDest)
reason: Teleport destination looked up by block size in Level.tp. It is read by the teleport branch of the applyEffect copairing.

name: 15-pad corner marks appearing when a 2x2 re-enters the pad (L5 last frame)
reason: Seen once, in the GAME_OVER frame of attempt 2. The meaning is unknown (it may frame a 4x4 at r36-39 c14-17), and no rule reads it.

name: R-grow placement (growTo: top = t-2; first fitting col of l-2, l-1, l; else no change)
reason: Fits both observed grows: (37,15)->(35,13) and (17,33)->(15,33). The order of the column tries and the no-fit branch are assumptions; neither case was observed.

name: left recipe panel clicks (show 0-hints) and board clicks
reason: Attempt 4: they cost 0 units and change no modelled slot; only the hint display changes. Act therefore has no such clicks.

name: ACTION5 / ACTION7
reason: The service rejects ACTION5 with 'action must be one of [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]'. No transition was recorded.
